title: Validate & warn on circular dependencies
description: Prevention already existed via validateDeps on every mutation (add/add-dep/update/MCP/webui). Added read-only detection (Store.FindCycles + shared findCycle/findCycles) and surfaced pre-existing cycles — which a git merge of two individually-valid edits can create unpreventably — in 'md doctor' (reports each cycle, exits non-zero) and as stderr warnings on 'md ready'/'md list' (stdout/JSON stays clean).
